decisions.reason: The lever family leverages the firm's existing door-hardware knowledge, enabling it to interpret market feedback and refine the range rather than withdraw it.
The multifunctional handle builds on known mechanical and electronic access capabilities, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to learn from ongoing results and improve it.
The collection's German Design Award and dedicated website presence signal strong early results that the firm can absorb and build on, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The finish applies to existing handle families and can be evaluated with the firm's proprietary finishing know-how, although it remains more replaceable if demand is weak.
